_comment: Copy this to sdlc.config.json in the root of the repository you are building. Every field is optional; the defaults shown here are what applies when the file is absent.
_gates: Each gate is off, warn or block. warn allows the edit and injects a reminder for the agent; block refuses the edit and tells the agent what to do instead. secrets defaults to block because a leaked credential is not a workflow preference.
_sessionContext: When true, each new session is given the constitution, the active features and their phases, and the active gates.
